value.request: Add request rate limiting to the API gateway. The limit must be enforced consistently across both the REST and GraphQL endpoints, and the rate counter must survive pod restarts.
value.context: Multi-component system with shared state requirements.

acceptance_checks.spec: Test suite confirms rate limiting blocks requests after threshold.
Both REST and GraphQL endpoints share the same rate counter state.
Rate counter state survives pod restart in the test environment.

pairing_rationale: Cross-component invariants require careful coordination and state management. High-effort models should catch the persistence requirement.
